title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Oil shock drags, breadth breaks.
Crude's 3.5% drop did not rescue equities: SPY -0.44% with 341 of 501 names lower and 90 new 60-day lows. Money rotated defensively into financials and healthcare while QQQ bled $1.8bn; this is distribution, not a dip.

INDICES — VIX 17.7, above its 15.8 20-day MA.
SOXX +0.64%, QQQ +0.03%, IWM -0.43%, SPY -0.44%, DIA -1.15%; STYLE: Large > Small by 0.45pp. Dollar +0.64% (UUP) the notable cross-asset move while WTI fell 3.52%. SPY sits below its 200-day MA with only 49% of S&P names above it — a CTA sell trigger.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.5x (accumulation), QQQ 1.1x (muted), both on down tape = distribution.
IJR 1.9x and DIA 1.8x show small caps and Dow names being actively sold. Only 31% of S&P names hold their 50-DMA, up/down volume 0.57, adv/dec 158/341, 8 highs vs 90 lows. Participation diverges hard from the flat index print — narrow mega-cap tape masking broad weakness.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLK +0.10%, XLV +0.07%, XLC +0.00%, XLF +0.00%, XLU +0.00%, XLE +0.00%, XLI -0.08%, XLP -0.48%, XLRE -0.60%, XLY -0.63%, XLB -0.73%.
Top industries WGMI +3.46% and SMH +0.64%; bottom FCG -5.63% and XOP -3.96%. Flows: XLF +$670mm (79p) and XLV +$48mm (52p) in, XLK -$542mm (6p) and XLY -$526mm (6p) out — leaders bleed while defensives fill, contradicting the price ranking. Money in: financials, healthcare. Money out: tech, discretionary. Rotation state: defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 0.82 neutral; QQQ PCR 2.04 and IWM 1.94 scream protection demand.
QQQ skew +10.8% put premium with ATM_IV 18.1%; IWM GEX flip 279 sits at spot, so dealer hedging amplifies moves. VIXEQ 36.5 vs VIX 17.7 — wide gap, low implied correlation, stock-picker's tape.

CROSS-ASSET — Oil -3.52% (USO, 20d still +19.52%) crushed energy but failed to lift transports: JBHT -13.30%. Dollar +0.64% pressured gold -0.61% and silver -0.83%. Next FOMC Oct 28; Polymarket prices 54% no change, 46% for a 25bp hike.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 43.4, Neutral.
JBHT -13.30% on CFO Q3 earnings-cut warning; FANG -8.03%; COP -6.15% on crude's pullback. Vol spikes: FANG 7.9x, JBHT 6.3x — both vol up, price down = distribution. Worst 20d sector XLI -8.10%; growth factor BEAR 242 days. Watch SOXX (5d -5.63%, 92p inflows, gamma-sensitive), KRE (-1.77%, 2.1x vol), and IWM (GEX flip at 279, RVX 21.5 above its 19.7 MA).
